failure.forbidden: You do not have enough rights for this action.
failure.setting_locked: The value is set by the environment and cannot be changed here.
failure.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.csrf_failed: The session is out of date: reload the page and try again.
failure.network: No connection to the server. Try again later.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again later.

secret.hint: Copy it now and pass it to whoever starts the runner.
secret.commandHint: Run it on the runner machine. The Studio address and the secret are already filled in; after the first start the runner stores its own token and the value can be removed from the environment.

runners.title: Runners
runners.lead: Machines that run builds and checks. The state is derived from the time of the last signal.
runners.caption: Runners
runners.noneOnline: No runner is online: builds and checks will wait in the queue until a runner connects.

empty.title: No runners yet
empty.body: Create a registration token and start a runner with it. Without runners no builds are executed.

rotateDialog.title: New token for {{name}}
rotateDialog.body: The previous runner token stops working and the runner loses its connection until it receives the new one. The secret is shown once.

rotated.title: New token for {{name}}
rotated.lead: The previous token no longer works.
rotated.label: Runner token

revoke.title: Revoke runner
revoke.body: The runner loses access and stops taking jobs. Jobs it is running are handed to another runner.

tokens.title: Registration tokens
tokens.lead: A one-time secret a new runner exchanges for its own token.

empty.title: No tokens
empty.body: Create a token when you need to connect a new runner.

form.title: New registration token
form.lead: The secret is shown once, right after it is created.
form.label: Name
form.labelHint: So you can tell later what it was for: for example, the server in room 305.
form.maxUsesHint: From 1 to 100. The token stops working after the last connection.
form.maxUsesInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke token
revokeDialog.body: Token "{{label}}" will stop accepting new runners. Runners already connected keep working.

queue.title: Job queue
queue.lead: What is waiting for a runner and what is running now. Updates by itself.
queue.caption: Job queue
queue.summaryFailed: Could not load the queue summary.

empty.title: The queue is empty
empty.body: Jobs appear here when someone starts a build or a check.

noMatch.title: Nothing found
noMatch.body: Change the filters or reset them.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel job
cancelDialog.body: The "{{kind}}" job of {{user}} will be stopped.
cancelDialog.running: It is already running: the runner will interrupt it and the result will not be saved.

quotas.title: Quotas
quotas.lead: How many jobs a person can run at once and how long a job may take.
quotas.note: Limits for individual organizations and people cannot be set from the interface yet.

concurrent.label: Concurrent jobs per person
concurrent.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000.

duration.label: Job time limit, min
duration.hint: From 0.5 to 1440 minutes. Empty means no limit; a longer job is stopped.

defaults.title: Installation limits
defaults.lead: They apply to everyone. When a limit is used up, a new job waits in the queue instead of being rejected.

userConcurrent.label: Concurrent jobs per person
userConcurrent.hint: From 1 to 1000. Empty means no limit.

orgConcurrent.label: Concurrent jobs per organization
orgConcurrent.hint: From 1 to 1000. Empty means no limit.

services.title: Services
services.lead: Everything Studio depends on. The state refreshes by itself and the button runs a check right away.

storage.title: Storage
storage.lead: How much space projects take and who takes it.
storage.low: Free space is running low: {{free}}. Free some space or extend the disk, otherwise saving files will stop working.

stats.projectsHint_one: {{count}} more deleted, waiting to be erased
stats.projectsHint_other: {{count}} more deleted, waiting to be erased

owners.title: Who owns the projects
owners.lead: Organizations and people with personal projects, by project count.

empty.title: No projects yet
empty.body: Data appears when people start creating projects.

storage.note: Counted from database records, without walking the storage. Data was updated {{ago}} ago.
